summary: The root عتد (Etd) refers to preparation and readiness. عَتَادٌ signifies apparatus, implements, or equipage, especially for war, like weapons and beasts.
lane: عَتَادٌ ذ (S, A, O, L, Msb, K) and , (L, K,) or , (so in the O,) Apparatus; syn. عُدَّةٌ [q. v.]; (S, A, O, L, K;) which is said by some to be formed from عُتْدَةٌ , but others deny this; (L;) implements, or instruments, or the like; (S, O;) or weapons, beasts, and instruments, or equipage, of war: (L, Msb:) pl. أَعْتُدٌ (O, L, Msb, K) and أَعْتِدَةٌ (L, Msb) [both pls. of pauc.] and عُتُدٌ . (L.) One says, أَخَذَ لِلْأَمْرِ عَتَادَهُ He took his apparatus, or implements, or instruments, or the like, [or he prepared, or provided, himself, ] for the affair: (S, O:) or he took, for the affair, what he had prepared of weapons, and beasts, and instruments, or equipage, of war. (Msb.) -b2- And sometimes, (S, O,) عَتَادٌ signifies also A large drinking-cup or bowl: (S, O, K:) i. q. عَسْفٌ and صَحْنٌ : (IAar, L:) or a large drinking-cup or bowl ( عُسٌّ ) of [ wood of the tree called ] أَثْل . (AHn, TA.)
